scope: Read-only static review plus pure-function micro-reproductions; no full-suite rerun, cloud, mounts, or workloads. Root-owned later edits excluded.
decision: fix three naming guard defects before accepting this HEAD; no other blocker found in examined conflict resolution

findings.title: Renamed workspace formats bypass required identity guard
findings.proof: fmt.startswith(workspace-) no longer matches workspace/native-workspace/entity-workspace. native_argv accepts workspace config with both workspace and workspace_namespace absent; main rejects equivalent workspace-v1 config.
findings.recommendation: Check explicit supported workspace-format set; add missing/empty ID/namespace cases.

findings.title: Historical flat-v1 cells bypass retired full-copy dispatch
findings.proof: suite_plan accepts old frozen flat-v1 names, but renamed retirement predicate matches flat only. Pure require_allowed(old C4/native/flat-v1, mount) passes here and is rejected on main.
findings.recommendation: Retire both flat and flat-v1 labels in central and standalone predicates; keep old plan bytes/hashes unchanged.

findings.title: Readonly adapter still selects retired packed format
findings.proof: native_argv allowlist retains packed-metadata-v3 and omits packed-snapshot. Frozen BrewFS7093 config.rs416/424/1326 and tests2982-84 require new PackedSnapshot format and reject old packed-metadata-v3.
findings.recommendation: Use packed-snapshot in current runtime allowlist and test new-format acceptance/old-format rejection; keep historical source-pinned scripts intact.
